name: Greater City Aquarium Society (GCAS)
neighborhoods: Queens / NYC; meets at Queens Botanical Garden
region_note: FISH & AQUATIC (aquarium fish, goldfish, bettas; aquatic turtles are under reptiles)
notes: NYC aquarium society founded 1922 (member of the Northeast Council of Aquarium Societies); monthly meetings at Queens Botanical Garden with a fish/plant/equipment auction open to the public. A Queens-side option for responsibly rehoming aquarium fish and getting care advice. Never release aquarium fish into local waters.
